545:t_027:10.en:
$$カスパー$$
「Answer us now. $$レナード$$ wants your answer quickly.」

545:t_027:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That guy...! Could he be $$ヴィルヘルム・カスパー$$!?」

545:t_027:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The first $$ロックオン$$ told me about him... He's a sniper whose skill goes beyond mastery. You could call him a demon.」

545:t_027:14.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Even $$ロックオン$$ thought that highly of him...」

545:t_027:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Of course I am. I'm the most unkillable man after $$キリコ$$.」

545:t_027:18.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That bastard $$カスパー$$ made a fatal mistake by showing himself outside his machine. I'll shoot him from here.」

545:t_027:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't worry. My $$Ｍ９$$ is already wrecked and useless...」

545:t_027:21.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm using a $$ウインチェスターＭ７０$$... I won't put so much as a scratch on $$テッサ$$.」

545:t_027:23.en:
$$クルツ$$
「The distance to him... is about 1,650 meters...」

545:t_027:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even that demon $$カスパー$$ probably tops out at 1,500 meters for a sniper shot.」

545:t_027:26.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But if $c surrenders to $$アマルガム$$ to save $$テッサ$$, all we'll get is a shitty ending.」

545:t_027:27.en:
$$クルツ$$
「If we waste time, you know $$テッサ$$... She might panic about being a burden and jump from there...」

545:t_027:28.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's how it is... I'm asking you to bet on my skill.」

545:t_028:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Remember this, $$ミシェル$$. A sniper absolutely must not miss when it counts most.」

545:t_028:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「All right... I'm going to do it. Pretend you're hesitating so he stays still.」

545:t_028:6.en:
$$カスパー$$
「I can't have you stalling forever. You have five more seconds to answer.」

545:t_028:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
(...Damn... I'm starting to feel dizzy...)

545:t_028:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
(I'm probably... not going to make it...)

545:t_028:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
($$宗介$$... Make sure you save $$カナメ$$...)

545:t_028:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
($$テッサ$$... I'll save you, so give up on that gloomy guy already and find yourself a good man.)

545:t_028:13.en:
$$クルツ$$
($$メリッサ$$... You're actually afraid of being lonely... I wanted to give you more affection...)

545:t_028:14.en:
$$クルツ$$
(I wonder if even a woman like you will cry... Will you...?)

545:t_028:15.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Part of me wants you to cry, and part of me doesn't... Maybe I shouldn't have slept with you after all...)

545:t_028:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
(And $$カスパー$$... You may think I'm a failure, but I have no intention of becoming a man like you...)

545:t_028:18.en:
$$クルツ$$
(You really were the best sniper... But when it came to killing a target, you didn't give a damn about hurting innocent people...)

545:t_028:19.en:
$$クルツ$$
(If that's what you call a real sniper, I don't want to become that kind of monster.)

545:t_028:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
(And I'll be damned if I let that monster do whatever he likes with my friends' lives.)

545:t_028:22.en:
$$クルツ$$
(I won't give up just because he's 1,650 meters away...)

545:t_028:23.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Wind, turbulence, temperature, humidity, tumbling, the Coriolis force...)

545:t_028:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
(I consider every factor, then clear my mind... I picture the trajectory by instinct.)

545:t_028:26.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm putting everything I've got into this...! Here goes!」

545:t_029:1.en:
$$カスパー$$
「That shot... shouldn't... have reached... me...」

545:t_030:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That... serves you right... $$カスパー$$...」

545:t_030:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You did it, $$クルツ$$! You hit him dead-on!」

545:t_030:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Heh heh... It was pretty impressive, huh...?」

545:t_030:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That really was... a shot I staked my life on...」

545:t_030:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You idiot, $$クルツ$$! After refusing all this time, are you going to draw the short straw at the very end!!?」

545:t_030:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Unfortunately, it looks that way... I'll... match skills... with the first $$ロックオン$$... in the afterlife...」

545:t_030:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm counting on you to take care of $$宗介$$, $n. You two... get along... and stop being the quiet type...」

545:t_030:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm sorry... $$宗介$$... I don't think... I can back you up anymore...」

545:t_031:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「We have confirmed $$アマルガム$$ and Imperial forces! They appear to be targeting each other!」

545:t_031:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...If we stay here with our forces this depleted, we will be wiped out.」

545:t_031:2.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant. We have no choice but to abandon recovering Uruz 6.」

545:t_100:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$始原の特異点$$. Your existence gave me a major clue for my plan too.」

545:t_100:1.en:
$$桂$$
「So I helped a villain without even knowing it.」

545:t_100:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「It isn't exactly a thank-you, but I'll eliminate you myself.」

545:t_100:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「After all, your existence distorted everything in the world!」
